summary: Ontario's tower layer lists a verified Kwinkwaga Lake Fire Tower east of the lake, with no height or build date; no source describes the site today.

evidence.supports: Tower layer record is a Fire Tower named Kwinkwaga Lake Fire Tower
Point is placed east of Kwinkwaga Lake
evidence.quote: "LOCATION_DESCR":"East of Kwinkwaga Lake Zone 16 624366 mE 5408686 mN"

evidence.supports: Point is accurate to within 10 metres
Height field is blank for this record
Construction date field is blank for this record
Firelookout.ca entry carries the same name
Firelookout.ca entry gives a Thunder Bay address
Firelookout.ca entry is marked Location not verified
Design idea: tall structure on a peak, a person living in it, reporting fires to crews
evidence.quote: The idea was simple: Build a tall structure on a hill or mountain peak, hire someone to live in it, and have them report fires to teams on the ground.

evidence.supports: At their peak Ontario had 325 lookouts
evidence.quote: At their peak, the towers sprawled throughout North America, with 325 lookouts across Ontario alone.

evidence.supports: As of 2013, the Ontario ministry had decided to remove many still standing towers
evidence.quote: The Ontario MNR has decided, as of 2013, to remove many of these still standing towers.

sources.title: Fire Tower records, tower layer (LIO_Open10, layer 14)
sources.publisher: Land Information Ontario, Government of Ontario

sources.title: The History of the Fire Tower: From World War II to Jack Kerouac to Temagami

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only the Ontario tower-layer point (verified, within 10 m, east of the lake) and Firelookout.ca's unverified entry under the same name were found. No source gives a height, build date, status, staffing, access or photo. One web search found no page about this tower. The story gives no build history, staffing or fate for it, only the layer's blank fields and general Ontario context from other pages, and it cannot say whether anything still stands. The Firelookout.ca entry is probably the same tower as ca-on-kwinkwaga-lake-2 (same name, about 2.9 km west); the editor should decide whether to merge or hide one. Context sentences about Ontario towers come from general pages, not about this site.
